hypotheses.reasoning: payment-svc started rolling out v1.18.0 at 05:43:46 (#102) and came up at 05:44:12 with 'response serializer v2 enabled' (#107). Twelve seconds later order-service began failing to decode /charge responses because the required field "status" was missing; the keys it got were id, state, updatedAt (#108, and again at #116, #119, #128). The new serializer changed the response contract. order-service then returned 502s to api-gateway, which is the alert (#114 onward). Before the deploy, payment-svc /charge calls succeeded with no errors. The disk warning (#39) and the single validation 400 (#55) come earlier and have nothing to do with this. Postgres and redis look healthy.
The serializer v2 flag could be read as a config toggle rather than a code change. But it came in with the versioned release, so bad_deploy fits better.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll payment-svc back to v1.17.9, or turn off response serializer v2. After that, either make v2 keep the \"status\" field or update order-service's decoder to read \"state\" before re-releasing. Reconcile any orders that may have been charged but then failed to decode.
